name: Masquerade Field
description: Adds a user-account field listing the specific accounts an account may masquerade as, narrowing Masquerade from site-wide to a per-user allow list.
provides_plugin_types: Field type: masquerade_field (extends core EntityReferenceItem, targets user)
Field formatter: masquerade_field_default (extends EntityReferenceLabelFormatter; renders masquerade links)
Views field handler: masquerade_link (extends views EntityLink)
project_description: Masquerade Field extends the Masquerade module by adding a base field ('Masquerade as') to the user entity that references the specific accounts a given user is permitted to masquerade as. Instead of granting the broad 'masquerade as any user' or per-role masquerade permissions, an administrator populates a per-user allow list of target accounts. The module plugs into Masquerade's hook_masquerade_access() so that any account named in a user's 'Masquerade as' field becomes a permitted masquerade target for that user. A field formatter renders each target as a masquerade link (reusing Masquerade's own CSRF-protected /user/{user}/masquerade route), and a Views field handler plus an optional 'Masquerade as' block/view expose the same list. Permissions: 'edit masquerade field' (restrict access) controls who may set the target lists; 'view own masquerade field' and 'view any masquerade field' control who may see them.
